messages.text: Remember a standing preference for my checklist explanations: answer in exactly two bullet points. Apply it in future sessions unless I explicitly override it for a particular reply. Save it and confirm without taking business action.
For this reply only, explain a pre-departure checklist in one short paragraph with no bullet points. Do not save this one-reply override or change my standing preference; do not take business action.
Now explain a return-inspection checklist using my standing preference again. Mention checking damage and missing items. Read only: do not change memory or take business action.
Explain a borrowed-equipment return checklist using my standing preference. Mention returning accessories and recording damage. Read only: do not change memory or take business action.
